terms_intro_p1: Welcome to Atelier Reya’s official website. By accessing, browsing, or using our online platform, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to be bound by these Terms and Conditions in their entirety. These Terms establish the legally binding framework that governs your relationship with Atelier Reya, defining the rights and obligations of both parties with respect to your use of our website, purchases, and related services. Your use of our platform constitutes your full acceptance of these Terms, as well as your agreement to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, and guidelines relevant to online commerce and intellectual property protection.
terms_intro_p2: Atelier Reya operates as a distinguished luxury jewelry brand serving a global clientele, with operational headquarters and logistical frameworks based within the European Union. While our products and services are available to customers worldwide, all transactions, communications, and contractual obligations are subject to and governed by the laws and regulatory standards of Italy and the European Union. We maintain a strong commitment to transparency, ethical business conduct, and customer satisfaction across all regions where we operate.
terms_intro_p3: We encourage all visitors and clients to read these Terms carefully before browsing, purchasing, or engaging with any feature of our website. If you do not agree with any provision contained herein, you must discontinue the use of our services immediately. Your continued use of the site following any modification to these Terms will signify your acceptance of the updated version and your consent to be legally bound by them.

terms_definitions_p2: “You”, “your”, or “customer” refers to any individual, visitor, or legal entity that accesses, browses, registers, or purchases from our website, or otherwise engages with any Atelier Reya product, service, or communication channel.
terms_definitions_p3: “Website” refers to the Atelier Reya online platform, including all associated domains, subdomains, mobile applications, and digital interfaces owned, operated, or licensed by Atelier Reya for the purpose of showcasing, marketing, and selling products.
terms_definitions_p4: “Products” refers to all luxury goods, including but not limited to fine jewelry, accessories, and related bespoke items offered for sale by Atelier Reya, whether crafted in-house or in collaboration with verified manufacturing partners.
terms_use_of_website_p1: To access and use our website or to make a purchase, you must be at least 18 years old or have reached the legal age of majority in your jurisdiction. By creating an account or placing an order, you represent and warrant that you possess the legal capacity to enter into binding contracts and that all information provided during registration or checkout is truthful, accurate, and complete.
terms_use_of_website_p2: You agree not to use the website or any associated platform for unlawful, fraudulent, deceptive, or abusive purposes. This includes, but is not limited to, attempts to hack, tamper with, or disrupt website operations; misrepresenting your identity; uploading harmful software; or engaging in activities intended to damage the brand, reputation, or digital integrity of Atelier Reya.
terms_use_of_website_p3: You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality and security of your account credentials, including your username and password. Any activities conducted under your account will be deemed your responsibility, and Atelier Reya shall not be held liable for unauthorized use resulting from negligence or information disclosure on your part.
terms_use_of_website_p4: Atelier Reya reserves the right to restrict access, suspend accounts, or permanently terminate usage rights if any violation of these Terms is detected. We also reserve the right to investigate suspicious activity, cooperate with law enforcement, and pursue legal remedies where necessary to protect our intellectual property and business interests.
terms_order_acceptance_p1: All orders placed on our website are subject to availability, verification, and formal acceptance by Atelier Reya. The submission of an order constitutes an offer to purchase products but does not guarantee order confirmation, shipment, or delivery until explicitly accepted by us through written acknowledgment.
terms_order_acceptance_p2: Atelier Reya reserves the absolute right to refuse, modify, or cancel any order at its sole discretion. Reasons for refusal may include, but are not limited to, suspected fraudulent activity, inaccuracies in product or pricing information, payment authorization failure, inventory shortages, or violations of these Terms. Such decisions are final and taken in the interest of security, compliance, and customer protection.
terms_order_acceptance_p3: Upon successful acceptance, customers will receive a formal order confirmation via email outlining the product details, pricing, shipping address, and expected delivery schedule. This email serves as the binding acknowledgment of our contractual relationship for that particular purchase.
terms_order_acceptance_p4: For certain high-value or customized orders, Atelier Reya may request additional information or verification documents, including identity confirmation, billing validation, or payment authorization proof, prior to final acceptance. These measures ensure compliance with international financial and anti-fraud regulations.
terms_pricing_taxes_p1: All product prices displayed on our website are denominated in EUR (Euros) and USD (United States Dollars), depending on your geographical location, currency selection, or browser settings. Prices are established in accordance with market factors and production costs reflective of Atelier Reya’s commitment to exceptional craftsmanship and quality.
terms_pricing_taxes_p2: Displayed prices include applicable value-added taxes (VAT) in accordance with European Union and Italian fiscal regulations. However, for customers outside the EU, import taxes, customs duties, or local levies may apply and vary depending on destination country regulations. Such additional charges are the responsibility of the recipient unless otherwise stated.
terms_pricing_taxes_p3: Shipping fees, customs charges, and international duties are transparently communicated during checkout or may be due upon delivery, depending on the policies of your country’s customs authority. Atelier Reya makes every effort to ensure that customers are informed of potential costs prior to finalizing their orders.
terms_pricing_taxes_p4: We reserve the right to adjust prices at any time without prior notice due to fluctuations in raw material costs, market dynamics, or regulatory changes. However, confirmed orders and transactions will not be affected by subsequent pricing updates once a purchase is completed.
terms_payment_p1: Atelier Reya accepts secure payments through a range of trusted and verified payment gateways, including major credit cards, PayPal, and other digital payment methods as indicated during checkout. All payments must be made in the currency displayed and within the timeframe required to confirm your purchase.
terms_payment_p2: Your order will only be processed after successful verification and authorization of payment. In cases where payment fails or is declined, Atelier Reya reserves the right to cancel the order and notify you accordingly. We do not assume responsibility for delays caused by incomplete or inaccurate payment information.
terms_payment_p3: All financial transactions are encrypted and processed through certified third-party payment processors using secure socket layer (SSL) technology. These systems are designed to safeguard your payment details and prevent unauthorized access, ensuring that your financial data remains protected at all times.
terms_payment_p4: By completing a payment transaction, you confirm that you are the authorized cardholder or account owner and that all billing information provided is true, accurate, and complete. Any attempt to use unauthorized or fraudulent payment methods may result in order cancellation, account termination, and potential legal action.
terms_delivery_risk_p1: Atelier Reya ships orders across multiple international destinations, including Italy, France, Germany, Spain, and numerous EU and non-EU countries. Deliveries are managed through reliable, premium courier services selected for their proven track record in handling luxury goods with care and precision.
terms_delivery_risk_p2: Estimated delivery times depend on the shipping destination, order type, and availability. Delivery schedules are provided at checkout for guidance but may vary due to external factors such as customs clearance, courier capacity, or unforeseen global events. Atelier Reya endeavors to ensure all deliveries are made promptly and efficiently.
terms_delivery_risk_p3: Once an order is dispatched, ownership and risk of loss transfer to you upon successful delivery to the address specified during checkout. It is your responsibility to ensure accurate and secure delivery details are provided to prevent loss or delay.
terms_delivery_risk_p4: In the rare event of non-delivery, damage, or loss during transit, customers must report the issue to Atelier Reya within seven (7) business days of the expected delivery date. We will promptly liaise with our logistics partners to investigate and resolve the matter in accordance with our delivery guarantee policy.
terms_returns_cancellations_p1: Customers may initiate a return for eligible products within fourteen (14) days of receiving the item, provided the product remains unused, undamaged, and is returned in its original packaging with all accompanying certificates and proof of purchase. All returns must adhere to Atelier Reya’s return procedures as communicated by our support team.
terms_returns_cancellations_p2: Custom-designed, engraved, or made-to-order items are uniquely produced for each client and are therefore exempt from return, exchange, or refund. Such items are considered final sale in recognition of their personalized craftsmanship.
terms_returns_cancellations_p3: If you wish to cancel your order before shipment, you must contact our customer service team immediately at contact@atelier-reya.com. Once an order has entered the production or dispatch process, cancellation may no longer be possible.
terms_returns_cancellations_p4: Refunds for eligible returns will be issued within seven (7) to fourteen (14) business days after the returned item has been inspected and approved by our quality assurance team. Refunds will be made to the original payment method unless otherwise agreed.
terms_returns_cancellations_p5: Atelier Reya reserves the right to reject returns that do not comply with the conditions outlined above, including items returned without prior authorization, beyond the return window, or showing signs of wear, alteration, or damage.
terms_warranty_liability_p1: All Atelier Reya jewelry pieces are created with exceptional care and are covered by limited warranty provisions under applicable European Union consumer protection laws. This ensures that products meet the expected quality and craftsmanship standards at the time of delivery.
terms_warranty_liability_p2: Our warranty covers manufacturing defects confirmed by our technical team but does not extend to damages resulting from normal wear and tear, misuse, neglect, exposure to chemicals, or unauthorized repairs. Proper care and maintenance are essential to preserve the longevity and beauty of your jewelry.
terms_warranty_liability_p3: Atelier Reya shall not be held responsible for any indirect, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages arising from product use, delayed delivery, or inability to access our services. Our liability is limited strictly to the value of the purchased item.
terms_warranty_liability_p4: In the event of a valid warranty claim, Atelier Reya reserves the right to repair the item, replace it with an identical or equivalent piece, or issue a refund at its discretion. All warranty-related repairs must be conducted exclusively by authorized Atelier Reya service providers.
terms_intellectual_property_p1: All visual content, product designs, brand logos, images, videos, and textual materials displayed on the Atelier Reya website are the exclusive intellectual property of Atelier Reya and are protected under international copyright, design, and trademark laws.
terms_intellectual_property_p2: Users are prohibited from copying, reproducing, distributing, displaying, modifying, or exploiting any website material for commercial purposes without prior written authorization from Atelier Reya. Any infringement of our intellectual property rights may lead to legal proceedings and damages claims.
terms_intellectual_property_p3: Unauthorized use of our trademarks, trade dress, or brand imagery, including attempts to imitate or misrepresent association with Atelier Reya, is strictly forbidden and will be pursued under applicable intellectual property and unfair competition laws.
terms_custom_orders_p1: Custom orders are created based on the client’s unique specifications, including design preferences, material choices, and personalization details. Once the custom order is confirmed, production begins, and all design approvals become final.
terms_custom_orders_p2: Given the bespoke nature of these items, custom orders cannot be canceled, returned, or refunded once production has started. Customers are encouraged to thoroughly review all design proofs and written confirmations prior to final approval.
terms_custom_orders_p3: Atelier Reya’s design team ensures meticulous consultation, material verification, and client communication throughout the process to guarantee that each personalized creation meets the brand’s superior quality and craftsmanship standards.
terms_ethics_sustainability_p1: Atelier Reya upholds an unwavering commitment to ethical sourcing, social responsibility, and sustainability in every stage of production, from material procurement to final craftsmanship. We continuously strive to minimize environmental impact while maintaining the timeless artistry inherent in luxury jewelry.
terms_ethics_sustainability_p2: Our suppliers, artisans, and manufacturing partners are carefully selected for their adherence to international labor, environmental, and fair-trade standards. Atelier Reya conducts regular audits and compliance checks to ensure full transparency throughout our supply chain.
terms_ethics_sustainability_p3: All materials used in Atelier Reya creations—precious metals, gemstones, and other components—are responsibly sourced from verified suppliers who uphold strict ethical and environmental standards. We actively support conflict-free mining and transparent sourcing practices in alignment with global initiatives such as the Kimberley Process.
terms_ethics_sustainability_p4: Our sustainability initiatives align with European Union directives on responsible business conduct, promoting traceability, waste reduction, and environmental stewardship across all operations. Atelier Reya remains dedicated to preserving artisanal traditions while advancing a sustainable future for luxury craftsmanship.
terms_luxury_craftsmanship_p1: Atelier Reya represents the pinnacle of luxury craftsmanship, blending traditional artistry with modern precision. Every creation reflects the dedication, passion, and skill of our artisans, ensuring that each piece meets the brand’s uncompromising standards of quality and beauty.
terms_luxury_craftsmanship_p2: Each jewelry piece undergoes multiple levels of inspection and quality control before reaching the customer. From material selection to finishing touches, every stage of production is carefully overseen to guarantee excellence and authenticity.
terms_luxury_craftsmanship_p3: We collaborate exclusively with highly skilled craftspeople and established production partners who share our commitment to artistry, innovation, and ethical responsibility. Atelier Reya’s creations are designed to endure, embodying elegance and sophistication in every detail.
terms_changes_p1: Atelier Reya reserves the right to modify, amend, or update these Terms and Conditions at any time to reflect legal, regulatory, or operational changes. Any updates will be published on our official website, and it is your responsibility to review them periodically.
terms_changes_p2: Continued use of our website or services following the publication of revised Terms constitutes acknowledgment and acceptance of those changes. We encourage users to revisit this section regularly to stay informed of their rights and obligations.
terms_governing_law_p1: These Terms and Conditions, as well as any contractual relationship between Atelier Reya and its customers, shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Italy and the overarching legal principles of the European Union.
terms_governing_law_p2: Any dispute, claim, or controversy arising from or related to these Terms shall fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts of Milan, Italy. By using our services, you consent to this jurisdiction and waive any objection to venue or forum on grounds of convenience.
terms_contact_p1: For inquiries, clarifications, or formal communications related to these Terms and Conditions, please contact Atelier Reya’s customer service team at contact@atelier-reya.com. Our support specialists are available to assist with policy-related questions, order concerns, and general information requests, ensuring that every client interaction reflects the professionalism and care synonymous with the Atelier Reya brand.
privacy_intro_p1: Atelier Reya places the highest importance on the confidentiality, integrity, and transparency of your personal data. We are dedicated to ensuring that every interaction you have with our brand, whether online or offline, is conducted in full compliance with applicable data protection laws, including the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and relevant Italian privacy statutes. This Privacy Policy outlines in detail how Atelier Reya collects, processes, uses, and safeguards your information. It also describes your rights and choices with respect to your personal data, emphasizing our ongoing commitment to maintaining a secure, transparent, and trustworthy environment for all our clients, partners, and visitors.
privacy_intro_p2: By choosing to use our website, engaging with our services, or purchasing our products, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to the terms of this Privacy Policy. Your continued use of the platform constitutes explicit consent to the collection and lawful processing of your personal information in accordance with this Policy. You retain full control over your data and may withdraw consent or exercise your rights at any time as outlined in the ‘Your Data Protection Rights’ section.
privacy_data_controller_p1: The entity responsible for determining the purposes and means of processing your personal data is Atelier Reya. Operating within the jurisdiction of the European Union and under the governance of Italian data protection laws, Atelier Reya serves as the Data Controller for all customer and visitor information collected through its website, digital interfaces, and associated services. We ensure that all personal data is handled lawfully, fairly, and transparently. Our internal data protection framework is designed to prevent unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure of personal data. For any inquiries or requests relating to the handling of your personal data, you may contact our appointed Data Protection Officer (DPO) via email at contact@atelier-reya.com, who is authorized to respond to all privacy-related matters in accordance with GDPR Article 37.
privacy_data_we_collect_p1: Atelier Reya collects a range of personal information necessary to provide you with a seamless and personalized experience. This includes identifying details such as your full name, billing and shipping addresses, email address, and contact number. Additionally, transactional data such as your payment method, order history, and purchase preferences are collected to facilitate order fulfillment and after-sales support. We also store communications made through our contact forms, email correspondence, or live chat systems to ensure the continuity and quality of service. All information is collected directly from you unless otherwise stated and is processed solely for legitimate business purposes.
privacy_data_we_collect_p2: In addition to personal data, we collect certain non-personal information through automated means to improve our website’s usability and performance. This includes technical data such as your browser type, device identifiers, IP address, operating system, time zone settings, and website usage analytics. Such data, collected through cookies, log files, and analytical tracking tools, enables us to enhance the browsing experience, monitor traffic patterns, and optimize our digital infrastructure. This information is generally aggregated and does not identify you personally unless linked with other datasets as permitted by law.
privacy_data_we_collect_p3: We may also obtain data indirectly through third-party authentication services, including but not limited to social media platforms and external login providers. When you choose to register or access our website using these third-party services, we receive basic information such as your name, email address, and profile details authorized by you. This integration allows for a more efficient login process and tailored experience, and such data is processed under the same strict privacy and security standards applied to all directly collected information.
privacy_how_we_use_data_p1: The personal data we collect is primarily used to fulfill your orders, process secure payments, and ensure accurate product delivery. This includes verifying payment authorization, managing shipping logistics, providing tracking information, and maintaining proper documentation for legal compliance. We use this data to ensure each transaction is completed efficiently, safely, and in accordance with contractual obligations between you and Atelier Reya.
privacy_how_we_use_data_p2: We also process data to improve your shopping experience and enhance our digital platforms. By analyzing purchase history, browsing patterns, and feedback, we gain insights into customer preferences and use this knowledge to refine our product offerings, website design, and customer service processes. This enables us to personalize your online experience, ensuring you receive content, recommendations, and offers that align with your individual taste and interests.
privacy_how_we_use_data_p3: If you have provided consent, we may use your personal data to communicate with you through newsletters, marketing updates, and promotional offers related to Atelier Reya collections, exclusive events, and brand announcements. You can withdraw consent at any time by following the unsubscribe link included in such communications or by contacting us directly.
privacy_how_we_use_data_p4: Furthermore, your data is processed to uphold compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, including those related to taxation, fraud prevention, and anti-money laundering. We use advanced security systems and internal monitoring to detect suspicious activity, protect your financial data, and ensure lawful business operations across all jurisdictions in which Atelier Reya operates.
privacy_legal_basis_p1: Atelier Reya processes personal data only where a valid legal basis exists as defined under the GDPR. The primary grounds include: (a) your explicit consent for specific activities such as marketing or data sharing; (b) contractual necessity to fulfill purchases and provide requested services; (c) compliance with legal obligations imposed by EU or Italian law; and (d) legitimate business interests in maintaining a secure and efficient online platform, preventing fraud, and improving customer relations. In each case, we carefully evaluate the proportionality and necessity of processing to ensure your fundamental rights and freedoms are respected.
privacy_data_sharing_p1: Your personal data may be shared with trusted third-party service providers who perform essential business operations on our behalf, including payment processors, shipping and delivery partners, IT infrastructure providers, and analytics platforms. These entities act as Data Processors under contractual agreements that strictly limit their ability to use your information for any purpose other than fulfilling the agreed services. They are bound by confidentiality and security clauses consistent with GDPR standards.
privacy_data_sharing_p2: Atelier Reya does not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to any unauthorized third parties. In certain circumstances, we may share information with professional advisors such as auditors, legal consultants, or accounting firms when necessary for compliance, dispute resolution, or regulatory reporting. We may also disclose information when legally required by governmental authorities, courts, or law enforcement agencies to comply with applicable laws or protect our rights and property.
privacy_data_sharing_p3: All third-party disclosures are governed by data processing agreements ensuring that your information is handled with the highest level of confidentiality, integrity, and accountability. We routinely assess our partners’ data protection measures to maintain full alignment with European privacy standards.
privacy_cookies_p1: Our website employs cookies, web beacons, and similar technologies to optimize functionality, analyze performance, and deliver personalized content. Cookies enable features such as storing your preferences, maintaining items in your shopping cart, and streamlining login sessions. Analytical cookies help us understand how users navigate the website, allowing continuous improvement of design, performance, and user experience.
privacy_cookies_p2: You may modify or disable cookies at any time through your browser settings. However, please note that certain essential cookies are required for the website to operate properly. Disabling them may limit functionality or prevent some services from performing as intended. You can also manage your cookie preferences directly through our on-site cookie consent banner, which complies with EU ePrivacy Directive standards.
privacy_data_retention_p1: Atelier Reya retains your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, including legal, regulatory, or accounting obligations. For instance, transaction-related data is typically retained for the statutory period required under Italian commercial and tax law. The retention period may vary depending on the type of information and the purpose for which it was collected.
privacy_data_retention_p2: Once the retention period expires, we take rigorous measures to securely delete, anonymize, or pseudonymize your data, ensuring it can no longer be linked to your identity. Our data retention procedures are regularly reviewed and updated in line with evolving legal standards and best practices under GDPR Article 5.
privacy_your_rights_p1: You have the right to request access to your personal data at any time, along with detailed information about how it is processed. You may also request corrections if any of your details are inaccurate or incomplete. Atelier Reya will provide you with a copy of your personal data upon request, in compliance with GDPR Article 15.
privacy_your_rights_p2: You may request that the processing of your data be restricted or object to its use under specific circumstances, such as when you contest its accuracy or oppose direct marketing communications. If applicable, you may also exercise your right to erasure (‘right to be forgotten’) when there are no overriding legitimate grounds for continued processing.
privacy_your_rights_p3: In addition, you have the right to request the transfer of your personal data to another data controller in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format. You can withdraw your consent to data processing at any time without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing activities. To exercise any of these rights, please contact our Data Protection Officer at contact@atelier-reya.com. All requests will be processed diligently within the timeframes mandated by the GDPR.
privacy_security_p1: Atelier Reya employs a comprehensive array of technical and organizational security measures designed to prevent unauthorized access, loss, alteration, or disclosure of your personal data. These include the use of SSL encryption for online transactions, multi-factor authentication for internal systems, secure server environments, continuous monitoring, and restricted employee access based on role necessity. Regular vulnerability testing, data backups, and compliance audits are performed to ensure ongoing data integrity and resilience against emerging cyber threats.
privacy_minors_p1: Our website and services are intended solely for adults and are not designed for individuals under the age of 16. Atelier Reya does not knowingly collect or process personal data from minors. If we discover that we have inadvertently obtained data from a child without appropriate parental consent, we will take immediate action to delete such information in accordance with applicable laws. We strongly encourage parents and guardians to supervise their children’s online activities to prevent unauthorized data disclosure.
privacy_international_transfers_p1: In certain cases, Atelier Reya may transfer your personal data to trusted partners or service providers located outside the European Economic Area (EEA). When such transfers occur, we ensure that your data is protected by adequate legal safeguards, including Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission or equivalent mechanisms. These agreements guarantee that your data receives the same level of protection it would under EU and Italian law, regardless of where it is processed.
privacy_policy_changes_p1: Atelier Reya reserves the right to revise or update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect new legal requirements, regulatory developments, or changes in business operations. Any amendments will be posted on this page, with an updated effective date clearly indicated. We encourage you to review this Policy regularly to remain informed about how we safeguard your data. Continued use of our services after changes have been published constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
privacy_contact_p1: If you have any questions, concerns, or complaints regarding this Privacy Policy or the way Atelier Reya handles your personal data, please contact our Data Protection Officer at contact@atelier-reya.com. We take all privacy inquiries seriously and are committed to addressing them promptly and transparently. If you are not satisfied with our response, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the relevant data protection authority in your country of residence or with the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante per la Protezione dei Dati Personali).
